news.title: Americans’ views of China have warmed in recent years
news.summary_en: Americans’ feelings toward China have warmed since 2021, though views remain mostly cold, with sharp partisan and generational divides.

news.title: Prediction markets’ trading volume doubled between May and July, largely driven by sports
news.summary_en: Prediction market trading on Kalshi and Polymarket doubled from May to July, mostly due to a large uptick in sports trading.

news.title: Americans’ views of data centers have turned more negative
news.summary_en: Americans’ views of data centers have turned more negative since January. But many are unsure or unfamiliar with them.

news.title: Tradition and Change Among Latter-day Saints in the U.S.
news.summary_en: Members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints are still highly religious and conservative, but signs point to demographic and social change.
